images.title: Alternating signs on 328105
images.purpose: Shows the alternating sign procedure: signs alternate from the units digit, and the total gives the remainder on division by 11.
images.composition: Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no characters, no extra text. One row of six digit tiles across the centre, each with its sign, and a result box at the right.
images.exact_structure: Six equal square tiles in one row, left to right holding −3, +2, −8, +1, −0, +5. Tiles with a plus are green (#009E73) outlined and tiles with a minus are vermilion (#D55E00) outlined. A small reddish purple (#CC79A7) arrow under the +5 tile points left, showing the signs start from the units digit. At the right end, a reddish purple (#CC79A7) rounded box holding = −3. Under the box: remainder 8. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: −3 + 2 − 8 + 1 − 0 + 5 = −3, so 328105 is 3 short of a multiple of 11 and leaves remainder 8.
